topic: A father's dignity is worth more than any money
title: आखिरी कुर्सी वाले पापा
setting: A small north Indian town in winter, warm ochre, marigold and maroon colours, soft golden afternoon light

characters.name: मुन्नी
characters.look: a cheerful 10-year-old Indian girl, two neat plaits tied with red ribbons, big brown eyes, navy blue school pinafore over a white shirt, red cardigan, black school shoes

characters.name: पापा
characters.look: a thin cycle-rickshaw puller in his 40s, sun-browned skin, short black hair, a few days of stubble, faded green half-sleeve shirt, grey checked towel over one shoulder, brown trousers, worn rubber chappals

characters.name: प्रिंसिपल मैडम
characters.look: a kind school principal in her 50s, silver hair in a low bun, round gold-rimmed glasses, maroon cotton sari with a cream border, a small bindi

hook.line: उस दिन स्कूल में सबसे पीछे एक रिक्शा खड़ा था।
hook.roman: Us din school mein sabse peeche ek rickshaw khada tha.
hook.image: the school ground on annual day, shiny cars parked at the front, one old cycle rickshaw parked alone at the very back near the gate, golden afternoon light
hook.image_b: a close view of the old rickshaw's worn seat with a grey checked towel left on it

beats.line: पसीने में भीगे पापा चुपचाप आखिरी कुर्सी पर बैठ गए।
beats.roman: Paseene mein bheege papa chupchaap aakhiri kursi par baith gaye.
beats.image: the last row of plastic chairs at the back of the school ground, papa sits down alone wiping his sweaty face with his towel
beats.image_b: papa pushes his worn chappals under the chair, looking down shyly

beats.line: आगे बैठे लोग उन्हें देखकर मुँह फेरने लगे।
beats.roman: Aage baithe log unhe dekhkar munh pherne lage.
beats.image: the row in front of papa, two well-dressed parents turn away from him with raised eyebrows
beats.image_b: papa lowers his eyes and holds his towel tight

beats.line: तभी मंच से आवाज़ आई, सबसे होनहार छात्रा, मुन्नी!
beats.roman: Tabhi manch se awaaz aayi, sabse honhaar chhatra, Munni!
beats.image: the marigold-decorated stage, madam at the microphone holding up a gold trophy, the crowd clapping
beats.image_b: munni gasps with joy in the front row, hands on her cheeks

beats.line: मुन्नी ने माइक पकड़ा और कहा, पापा को ऊपर बुलाइए।
beats.roman: Munni ne mic pakda aur kaha, papa ko upar bulaiye.
beats.image: on the stage munni holds the microphone with both hands and points towards the last row
beats.image_b: every head in the crowd turns around towards the back

beats.line: पापा काँपते पैरों से मंच तक पहुँचे।
beats.roman: Papa kaanpte pairon se manch tak pahunche.
beats.image: the stage steps, papa climbs up slowly holding his towel, surprised and shy, munni waiting with open arms
beats.image_b: munni hugs papa tightly on the stage

beats.line: मुन्नी ने ट्रॉफी उनके हाथों में रख दी।
beats.roman: Munni ne trophy unke haathon mein rakh di.
beats.image: a close detail on the stage, munni's small hands placing the gold trophy into papa's rough hands
beats.image_b: papa's eyes fill with tears as he looks at munni

beats.line: उस दिन सबसे ज़्यादा तालियाँ आखिरी कुर्सी वाले को मिलीं।
beats.roman: Us din sabse zyaada taaliyan aakhiri kursi wale ko milin.
beats.image: the whole school ground standing and clapping for papa and munni on the stage, golden evening light
beats.image_b: madam smiles and joins her hands in respect to papa

moral.line: याद रखना, इज़्ज़त कपड़ों से नहीं, मेहनत से मिलती है।
moral.roman: Yaad rakhna, izzat kapdon se nahi, mehnat se milti hai.
moral.image: a town road at sunset, papa pedals his rickshaw home with munni in the back holding the trophy high

ask: आपको अपने पापा की कौन सी मेहनत याद है?
ask_roman: Aapko apne papa ki kaun si mehnat yaad hai?

आखिरी कुर्सी पर बैठे पापा, और मंच पर खड़ी बेटी ❤️
इसे अपने पापा को भेजिए।
